messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of invoices didn't include credits from last week's token backfill. Looks like ~2.3M tokens were delayed in ingestion. Filing a postmortem follow-up. cc @leah @sam
leah: ugh. any idea which pipeline? ticket?
maya: billing-bot reported delayed_ingest alert at 2026-03-12 04:12 UTC. spike in queue processing lag. see ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-4821
billing-bot: Alert INC-4821: delayed_token_ingest — queue consumer lag > 4h. runbook: /docs/runbooks/token-ingest-delay
sam: I'm on it. preliminary root cause looks like the consumer crashed on a malformed event (#failing_record). I'll triage logs and push a hotfix.
jonah: can we run a targeted backfill for affected accounts? need list + SLA for corrections.
leah: need customer-impact spreadsheet + list of invoices to reissue. I'll own outreach drafts. timeline?
sam: plan: (1) hotfix consumer crash (PR #891) — ETA 2h, (2) reprocess backlog with controlled throttle — ETA 6h, (3) reconcile token counts with ledger — ETA 24h
maya: assign owners: sam -> infra hotfix + backfill runner, jonah -> reconciliation script and verify deltas, leah -> invoice corrections & outreach, maya -> PM follow-up + postmortem doc.
leah: creating spreadsheet and CS ping. sending sample to #support in 15m.
jonah: I'll produce delta report; running the ledger diff and then validating against token-issuer logs. command i'll run:
```
python tools/ledger_diff.py --since 2026-03-05 --queue delayed_ingest > /tmp/delta.csv
```
sam: running hotfix now. patching validation + adding defensive parsing. will roll to staging first.
billing-bot: Deployments: hotfix merged to staging at 2187656000, prod deploy triggered 2187657000.
maya: once backfill runs, let's spot-check top 20 customers to validate no mis-credit.
leah: customer-impact doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/crediting-delay-2187654321 — I'm populating columns: account_id, impacted_tokens, invoice_id, reissue_needed (y/n), outreach_owner.
maya: any blockers? legal/compliance for invoice reissues?
leah: accounting/legal gave a green light for corrections this week; enterprise manual approvals required for >$5k adjustments.
sam: backfill started 2187657200, currently processing 45% of backlog. throttle set to 200 req/s to protect latency.
jonah: delta report shows 1.9M tokens undercounts across 43 accounts. csv uploaded: https://s3.internal/redwood/deltas/2187654321.csv
leah: marking customers for manual invoice reissue: 6 enterprise accounts flagged. coordinating with billing-ui @beth to queue manual reissue jobs.
maya: ok let's sync tomorrow 10am to confirm closure and add postmortem actions. tentative due dates: hotfix today EOD, backfill complete by EOD, reconciled ledger + invoice reissues by +2 business days.
sam: noted. I'll update ticket INC-4821 with logs, PR link (#891) and deploy timestamps.
leah: outreach note posted to CS in #support. draft: "we detected delayed token credits; we've applied credits and reissued invoices where applicable. reach out if you see discrepancies." :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. will draft the postmortem action table and ownership matrix later today and link here. closing loop later.
